name: request_child
description: Submit separate Fleet work. Reuse requestId on retry. After acceptance finish your turn so the child can run; do not wait or claim completion.

name: project_context
description: The project's settings and context. The host supplies the project; no arguments.

name: catalogue
description: List the methods available in this project and the current recommendation. No arguments.

name: pipeline_run
description: Run the project's method for a capability on query, and on files: each input is a file you saved with artifact_save (a files_get download included), given to the method as example/<path>; call it once artifact_list shows the file stored. Reuse requestId on retry: the same requestId returns the same run. A search may return a durable running run; read it with pipeline_get by runId, never redispatch after an uncertain response. If truncated is true, use pipeline_get with the returned id for details.

methodId.description: Choose an enabled method ID from the catalogue response for this project. Omit to use the project recommendation.

inputs.description: Files for the method: [{path, artifactId}] or [{path, ref: {connection, path}}], path a relative file name such as passport.jpg. ref names a file on one of the project's files grants (connection such as dam-files, path the server's own path); Fleet reads and stores it before the run, so you need not download it first.

wait.description: false answers the started run at once; follow it with pipeline_get. Omitted, the call waits for the run to end.

name: direct_search
description: Run a direct search for query, as pipeline_run. Reuse requestId on retry; read a running run with pipeline_get by runId.

methodId.description: Choose an enabled method ID from the catalogue response for this project. Omit to use the project recommendation.

name: pipeline_history
description: Page through this project's pipeline runs oldest first. Pass nextCursor as cursor to continue. Use pipeline_get for full run details.

name: pipeline_get
description: Read a pipeline run in this session's project by runId. To inspect a pipeline step, pass its parent run's ID as runId and find the step in plan.entries. Use pipeline_history to find run IDs in this project.

name: question_ask
description: Ask the project's people a question. Reuse requestId on retry; the answer appears in question_history.

name: question_history
description: The project's questions and their answers. No arguments.

name: account_list
description: The subscriptions this work may use (the director's, or taken for this project). No arguments.

name: connections_key_request
description: Ask the owner to add an API key to a Fleet connection. Never pass a key value: the owner pastes it into a field Fleet shows them, and the answer in question_history is only {connection, fingerprint, state} or decline. Reuse requestId on retry.

connection.description: The connection name, as in the API keys screen.

reason.description: Why the work needs the key.

name: access_grants
description: This project's access to its own servers (docs/designs/fleet-project-access.md): the access servers (state, the MySQL and PostgreSQL database names a check found) and the project's grants with state (asked, provisioning, ready, failed, declined, withdrawn, revoking, revoked), scope, recipe, last probe and, once ready, the connection whose tools read the resource (<project>-mysql or <project>-postgres: sql_schema, sql_query; <project>-files: files_list, files_get). Never a credential.

name: access_grant_ask
description: Ask the owner for access to one resource of this project on an access server: a MySQL or PostgreSQL database's tables (kind mysql or postgres, scope {database, tables}; postgres may exclude tables from ["*"]) or folders (kind files, scope {paths}), level read (write only when the work needs it). The owner gets an approval card with the exact recipe; after Approve Fleet provisions it, probes that reading works and writing is refused, and opens a connection whose tools you get on your next turn. Read the state with access_grants by requestId. Reuse requestId on retry. Ask only for what the task needs.

server.description: The access server's id, from access_grants servers.

scope.description: mysql: database and tables (or ["*"]); postgres: the same, plus exclude (tables left out of ["*"]); files: absolute folder paths on the server.

reason.description: Why the work needs it; the owner reads it on the card.

name: artifact_save
description: Store a regular file with a link count of one as an artifact of this execution now. Pass a path relative to the working area (worktree), or an expanded absolute path under that area, the run's $TMPDIR or $FLEET_INPUT_DIR. Symlinks below these roots and .. path components are refused. If an ordinary /tmp path is refused, copy the file into the run's $TMPDIR and pass the resulting absolute path. A files_get download path works as returned. required=true makes the run wait for storage. FLEET_OUTPUT_DIR is collected when the run ends.

name: artifact_list
description: List artifact metadata, newest first, 50 per call; never returns content. Without arguments: this execution's artifacts. scope="project" lists the whole project; execution_id or task_id list another execution or task. A reply with nextCursor has more: call again with cursor set to it.

name: artifact_get
description: Download an artifact into FLEET_INPUT_DIR and return its local path and metadata.

name: session_start
description: Start a new Fleet session in your project: requestId, preset (an id from session_presets) or role (pm|worker|reviewer from the project roles) or profileId, optional access read|write and branch true|false (override the preset; write needs a branch), text (first turn), setup run|skip. You are woken with a message when it finishes.

name: session_presets
description: List your own project's presets for session_start: id, name, what it does, the profile it starts (only profiles your project maps to roles can start), access read|write, branch, starter instruction; unavailable says why one cannot start.

name: session_transition
description: Fleet agent session tool session_transition (bound to this session by the host)

name: session_fork
description: Fleet agent session tool session_fork (bound to this session by the host)

name: session_resume
description: Fleet agent session tool session_resume (bound to this session by the host)

name: session_handoffs
description: Fleet agent session tool session_handoffs (bound to this session by the host)

name: session_rename
description: Name this conversation: title (up to 200 characters after whitespace is collapsed, never a UUID). An explicit title is kept; the generated title never replaces it

name: queue_list
description: Fleet agent session tool queue_list (bound to this session by the host)

name: ask
description: Ask a fresh question with question and requestId. Include taskId for an existing-task blocker. To read an existing answer, pass only resume with the question ID. Never combine the modes or put continuation prose in resume.

question.description: Fresh question text. Supply requestId with it.

taskId.description: The task for a fresh question about an existing-task blocker.

resume.description: An existing question ID. Supply resume alone to read its answer.

name: reply
description: Fleet agent session tool reply (bound to this session by the host)

name: questions
description: Fleet agent session tool questions (bound to this session by the host)

name: worker_done
description: Fleet agent session tool worker_done (bound to this session by the host)

name: execution_status
description: State of your execution, or with sessionId the latest execution of a session you started

name: agent_tool_result
description: Look up a pending Fleet call by requestKey from the same command and execution. A settled receipt returns the original operation's outcome, which may be a refusal. While the outcome is pending, check the same key again and do not repeat the operation.
